title: Restriction of a single chart prefix equals the direct composite-square prefix
statement: Let N>0, A be a finite commutative ring with NA=0, t its normalized finite Tate transport, S a Noetherian scheme with N invertible, and F a locally free O_S-module of rank d≥0. Let U≤V be opens and e a frame on V. Use the actual chart, coefficient and compact-support constructions of [def-amb-vector-integration-charts], the affine tower exchange and right comparison of [def-amb-affine-trace-construction], and the linear coefficient descent of [def-amb-affine-linear-trace-action]. Restrict the three-factor chart prefix from V to U by the inverse-image compositor, inverse image of that prefix, affineTraceExchange on R_V(1_V), and affineTraceLeft applied to affineTraceRightBaseChange followed by the constant-unit pullback. This composite equals vectorIntegrationCartesianPrefix of [lem-amb-vector-integration-cartesian-prefix-action] for p=π_F, f=U→S, q=affineTraceMap(U→V,d) followed by the inverse-frame chart, L=affineLinearBaseCoefficient(S,d), and b=vectorIntegrationBaseCoefficientPullback(U→S,d). This compares one frame to its direct restriction; no change-of-frame matrix, action or second frame occurs.

proof.text: Install the geometry of the bundle and the Noetherian opens and towers. Use affineTraceUnitCompactComparison_baseChange to replace inverse comparison followed by tower exchange and right-coefficient base change by ordinary tower exchange, ordinary compact-support image of that coefficient map, and inverse comparison over U.

Apply naturality of ordinary tower exchange to vectorIntegrationChartCoefficient. Paste the tower square with the inverse-frame square using affineLinearExchange_paste. Use the named equality U→S=(U→V→S); the pasted chart is vectorIntegrationRestrictedChart. Cancel the source inverse-image compositor with its inverse.

Combine the three coefficient maps using functoriality of ordinary compact-support pushforward and substitute vectorIntegration_restricted_chart_coefficient. The result is definitionally vectorIntegrationCartesianPrefix, with the same final comparison over U.

proof_origin.place: Overlap calculation; Lean assembly of compact-comparison transport, exchange naturality and pasting, and the strictly coefficient-only restriction identity (H4, 2026-10-26).

theorem vectorIntegration_restricted_chart_transport
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (hA : (N : A) = 0) (t : OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A N hA)
    (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian S] (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤))) (d : ℕ)
    (F : S.Modules) [F.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank d]
    (U V : S.Opens) (hUV : U ≤ V)
    (e : VectorBundleZeroSection.Trivialization S d F V) :
    letI : IsAffineHom (VectorBundleZeroSection.π S d F) :=
      (vectorIntegration_geometry S d F).1
    letI : LocallyOfFiniteType (VectorBundleZeroSection.π S d F) :=
      (vectorIntegration_geometry S d F).2.1
    letI : TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace U.toScheme :=
      U.ι.isOpenEmbedding.isInducing.noetherianSpace
    letI : IsNoetherian U.toScheme :=
      { toIsLocallyNoetherian := inferInstance
        isCompact_univ := TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace.isCompact _ }
    letI : TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace V.toScheme :=
      V.ι.isOpenEmbedding.isInducing.noetherianSpace
    letI : IsNoetherian V.toScheme :=
      { toIsLocallyNoetherian := inferInstance
        isCompact_univ := TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace.isCompact _ }
    (leftDerivedUpperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (S.homOfLE hUV) V.ι U.ι
      (S.homOfLE_ι hUV).symm).hom.app (vectorIntegrationSource A N hA S d F) ≫
      (ordinaryFinitePullback A (S.homOfLE hUV)).map
        ((rightDerivedLowerShriekBaseChangeMap A
          (vectorIntegrationChart_isPullback S d F V e)).app
            (vectorIntegrationCoefficient A N hA S d F) ≫
          (rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
            (affineTraceProjection V.toScheme d)).map
              (vectorIntegrationChartCoefficient A N hA t S hS d F V e).hom ≫
          (affineLinearCompactComparison N hN A hA V.toScheme
            (affineTracePullbackInvertible N V.ι hS) d).inv) ≫
      (affineTraceExchange A (S.homOfLE hUV) d
        ((affineTraceRight A N hA V.toScheme d).obj (ordinaryFiniteUnit A V.toScheme)) ≫
        (affineTraceLeft A U.toScheme d).map
          (affineTraceRightBaseChange A N hA t (S.homOfLE hUV)
            (affineTracePullbackInvertible N V.ι hS) d (ordinaryFiniteUnit A V.toScheme)).hom ≫
        (affineTraceLeft A U.toScheme d).map
          ((affineTraceRight A N hA U.toScheme d).map
            (ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback A (S.homOfLE hUV)).hom)) =
    vectorIntegrationCartesianPrefix N hN A hA t (VectorBundleZeroSection.π S d F)
      U.ι (affineTracePullbackInvertible N U.ι hS) d
      (vectorIntegrationRestrictedChart S d F U V hUV e)
      (vectorIntegrationRestrictedChart_isPullback S d F U V hUV e)
      (affineLinearBaseCoefficient A N hA S d)
      (vectorIntegrationBaseCoefficientPullback A N hA t U.ι hS d)
